scope: Preserve the virtual passkey authenticator while reading recovery-journal identity evidence.
rootCause: The recovery-journal observer detached a separate CDP session, disabling the virtual WebAuthn environment owned by the test harness. The next passkey unlock had no virtual authenticator.

diagnostics.secrets: Only lifecycle labels, counts, and booleans retained; no credentials, key material, recovery codes, or auth tokens.
diagnostics.instrumentation: Temporary diagnostics removed before final verification.

fix: Use the harness-owned initialized CDP session for journal reads. Release the inspected remote object instead of detaching the session.

verification.command: SEAMS_INTENDED_PRODUCTION=1 SEAMS_INTENDED_SKIP_BUILD=1 node tests/scripts/run-wallet-intended-isolated.mjs --require-google-token -- e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.recovery.contract.test.ts e2e/intended-behaviours/google-email-otp.recovery.contract.test.ts --grep 'a committed .* recovery survives a lost finalization response and runtime reset'
cases: [wallet-intended] 1/2 e2e/intended-behaviours/google-email-otp.recovery.contract.test.ts:66 a committed Google recovery survives a lost finalization response and runtime reset
[wallet-intended] 2/2 e2e/intended-behaviours/passkey.recovery.contract.test.ts:99 a committed Passkey recovery survives a lost finalization response and runtime reset

limitations: Direct rotateCodes and syncAccount acceptance remain open.
Full worker-loading and cross-browser matrix remains open.
Other CDP observers must finish after the last WebAuthn operation.
